title: Structural Affinity: An Algorithm for Coherent Cage-Based Shape Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.23173v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cage-based deformation (CBD) parametrises 3D geometry through a small set of control handles, effectively enabling a variety of tasks from animation and interactive modelling to tool-based co-design, neural deformation transfer, and aerodynamic shape optimization. Many optimization approaches relying on CBD employ regularisation strategies to reduce the distortion of the deformed mesh by encouraging smooth, regular cage deformations. These techniques offer soft guidance to an optimization algorithm towards desirable deformations, but compete with the task objective rather than changing the deformation parameterization itself. In this work we introduce Structural Affinity for CBD, an explicit regularisation method which enables smooth deformations through control cages by exploiting a two-cage structure to couple cage-handle motion directly. translated_title: 结构亲和性：一种实现连贯的基于笼体的形状设计算法
translated_abstract: 基于笼体的变形（CBD）通过一小组控制手柄对三维几何进行参数化，有效地支持从动画和交互式建模，到基于工具的协同设计、神经变形迁移以及空气动力学形状优化等多种任务。许多依赖CBD的优化方法采用正则化策略，通过鼓励平滑、规则的笼体变形来减少变形网格的失真。这些技术为优化算法提供了朝向理想变形的软引导，但它们是与任务目标相竞争，而不是改变变形参数化本身。在这项工作中，我们为CBD引入了结构亲和性，这是一种显式正则化方法，通过利用双笼结构直接耦合笼体-手柄的运动，从而实现通过控制笼体的平滑变形。结构亲和性使用均值坐标预计算一个亲和矩阵，将内部……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出结构亲和性方法，通过双笼结构和基于均值坐标预计算的亲和矩阵直接耦合笼体-手柄运动，作为显式正则化手段实现基于笼体变形的平滑连贯形状设计。
